We need to determine relation between two yes/no questions.

Question1: "O programa de Aluguel Social para vítimas de violência doméstica deve ser aprovado?" So asks whether the program should be approved.

Question2: "Os recursos destinados à Casa da Mulher Brasileira devem ser repassados diretamente ao Ministério das Mulheres, em vez de passar pelo Ministério da Justiça?" This asks about allocation of resources: should they be transferred directly to Ministry of Women instead of through Ministry of Justice.

These are different issues: one is about approving a specific program (Social Rental for victims). The other is about the channel of funding for a different institution (Casa da Mulher Brasileira). Even though both relate to women and domestic violence, they are distinct policy decisions. So relation = DIFFERENT.
